tests.result: format self-check: 10 fields + crypto additions present per proposal — VERIFIED for P1-A (SETTLE-SWEEP-ABSORB) and P1-B (SETTLE-BREAK-CASCADE); each states payer, premium, persistence, risk transferred, observable with t_known/pivot-lag/PROXY_NOT_ORDERBOOK, horizon+clock with flat-by-settlement, capacity, cost decomposition base+stress, falsifier with named controls, controls/baseline + vol incrementality design; PIT/intrabar law respected (cross-bar sweep->reclaim sequence, N>=1 bar pivot confirmation lag >=6 bars, next-bar-open opposite-quote fill, no intrabar ordering, trailing-closed ATR only)

authority_claims: outcome-blind honored: no outcome/ledger/MAP/LESSONS files read
read only plans/PLAN_srlv_cx_cohort_1.md and plans/PLAN_srlv_program_v1.md plus the dispatch packet

known_limitations: SOLUSDT/BNBUSDT funding NOT staged: both proposals are flat-by-settlement by construction (base-book funding = 0 for all pairs), but the measured-path funding stress arm is BTC/ETH only; SOL/BNB stress arms BLOCKED pending staging

spread/slippage census NOT_RUN: fill quality class is DECLARED (5 bps + 1 adverse tick per side); per-fill-time tick/price computation required (SOL early-sample tick burden up to ~50 bps/tick at 2020 price floor); proposals state exactly which census artifacts are needed to upgrade

premium figures are order-of-magnitude priors with reasoning, not measurements; both proposals pre-register K-COST ceiling checks (gross median per event must clear stress RT ~17 bps on the anchor's own fill distribution)
power risk: settlement-restricted event counts may fall below the >=100 RT floor per direction -> NOT_RUN_THIN is a legitimate pre-registered death

no order book / liquidation tape / OI: every level/sweep/absorption observable is a geometric proxy labeled PROXY_NOT_ORDERBOOK; payer testability is encoded via the settlement-shifted placebo and placebo-level controls

both proposals share one new payer family (funding-settlement forced flow) with opposite directional claims (H3 absorption vs H2 cascade); distinctness is directional and they are mutual inverted controls — council may score P1-A alone

P1-A sits near the dead band-fade+reclaim-gate class and P1-B near the dead BTC H4 Donchian class; both explicitly invoke the master-plan SRLV-PROGRAM-V1 section 2.2 revival clause (NEW payer + NEW measured information layer) with pre-registered withdrawal concessions if the skeptic rules the clause inapplicable
settlement-window conditioning uses the funding TIME schedule only, never funding rate levels, to respect ancestry fence 4 (funding-level gating)
